summary: Add an execution node under Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Instances > Create Instance, download and untar the install bundle, install the receptor collection, set ansible_user and SSH key in the inventory, and run ansible-playbook install_receptor.yml -i inventory.yml.
questions: How do I add an execution node to AAP on OpenShift?
Where do I download the execution node install bundle?
How do I upgrade an execution node added from the bundle?

answer_card.title: Add an execution node (operator)
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Instances > *Create Instance* (host name, optional listener port).
2. Download *Install Bundle*, untar it.
3. `ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml`
4. Set `ansible_user` and the SSH key in `inventory.yml` (`ansible_host` must match the UI).
5. `ansible-playbook install_receptor.yml -i inventory.yml`

Re-run the downloaded playbook to upgrade the node.
